responsibility: This module implements GCC’s tree-level vectorization subsystem, which recognizes scalar GIMPLE code that can execute in SIMD form and rewrites it into vector operations for both loops and straight-line basic blocks. Its core covers top-level vectorizer pass orchestration and shared metadata in tree-vectorizer.*, statement analysis and vector code generation in tree-vect-stmts.*, memory/data-reference and alignment handling in tree-vect-data-refs.*, loop-specific legality, profitability, control restructuring, peeling, versioning, and epilogue handling in tree-vect-loop.* and tree-vect-loop-manip.*, and SLP analysis, scheduling, pattern rewriting, and emission in tree-vect-slp.* and tree-vect-slp-patterns.*. The module also includes generic idiom recognition in tree-vect-patterns.*, post-vectorization generic lowering for unsupported vector operations in tree-vect-generic.*, and vector constant construction support in tree-vector-builder.*, making it the main middle-end subsystem responsible for analyzing, transforming, and finalizing SIMD vector code at the GIMPLE/tree stage.
